title: Memory-access exit labels
statement: For a natural number $K_0$, assign an exit label to each memory-access site and Boolean outcome. At an initial-code marking site, either outcome proceeds to the next initial-marking index with the same Boolean parameter. At a relaxation-round read of $U$, true proceeds to the read of $V$ and false to the next $U$; at a read of $V$, true proceeds to the next $V$ and false to the step-decider query. At a marking site for $V$, either outcome proceeds to clear the change flag. At a count read of $U$, true proceeds to increment the count and false to the next $U$. At the final-scan read of $U$, true proceeds to the accepting-code query and false to the next $U$.
